status: final outcome-blind provenance follow-up before comparative-programme structural-scarcity closure

source.study: Foraging movements of Lyle's flying foxes in Cambodia (data from Choden et al. 2019)

paper_reports.sampling: collars 1-5 nominally 30-min; collars 6-14 nominally 30-min first night then 5-min on following nights

allowed_operations: resolve DOI and follow public redirects
read landing-page HTML and repository metadata
enumerate public bitstream/file names, sizes, checksums and content links
read only the first CSV header row or equivalent schema metadata
read reference-data header if needed to distinguish event from reference files
forbidden_operations: read numeric event rows beyond the header
parse, summarize or plot any altitude/height value
infer vertical eligibility from vertical magnitudes
change accepted vertical-field names after seeing data values
decision_rule: Identify event-like CSV/TSV files from repository file names and headers only.
PASS_TO_STRUCTURAL_PREFLIGHT only if one event file contains individual, timestamp, longitude, latitude and at least one accepted native vertical field.
If public repository files cannot be enumerated or header-read, classify PENDING_ACCESS rather than infer.
If event header lacks accepted native vertical field, classify REJECT_NO_VERTICAL_RESPONSE.
No event values may be opened in this audit.
claim_boundary: This Cambodia dataset is distinct from the Airflows Thailand 2012 Pteropus panels.
Header PASS does not imply structural eligibility under the >=50-fix rule.
Header FAIL closes this provenance follow-up; do not add new search terms inside comparative-generality v1.
